scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate TOL palette with rank-encoded colors, clean search UI with inline badge counts, and confident whitespace — but the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport with large empty space below, and the pink collapse-count badges visually compete with the node circles.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no quantitative encoding violations (no bars, areas, or size-encodes-data); structurally honest with data-driven SVG sizing via d3.extent/d3.max, but key functions use name+depth strings instead of stable IDs, making DOM updates fragile under permutation if node names are non-unique.
scores.stress_test_note: Search input is properly debounced (200ms) and pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, but the toggle click handler calls update() without first calling .interrupt() on in-flight transitions, allowing rapid node clicks during the 500ms transition to queue conflicting animations and cause positional jumps.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with a 6-color rank palette, progressive disclosure via collapse, and a search-to-expand pattern keeps working memory load low at any given depth; the screenshot shows a clean 3-level state with readable labels and clear hierarchy, with no overload risk until fully expanded across all ~200 nodes simultaneously.

proposer: 595 lines, down 8 from 603. Collapsed the multi-line `fill` and `stroke` callbacks for circle styling into single-line ternary expressions — same logic, fewer lines.
